description:
Powerful 1000W Rear Hub Motor:The 1000W rear hub motor delivers ample power and torque, providing an exhilarating riding experience. It allows riders to effortlessly reach speeds of 30-50 km/h, making it suitable for both leisurely rides and quick commutes.

Versatile 21-Speed Gears:With 21-speed gears, our product allows for smooth and effortless shifting, offering riders a wide range of options to tackle various terrains and riding conditions.

Impressive Range: The lithium battery combined with efficient power management enables a remarkable range of 31-60 km per charge. Whether you're commuting or going on longer adventures, our product has got you covered.

Lightweight and Durable Aluminum Alloy Frame:Crafted from high-quality aluminum alloy, our product offers both strength and lightweight maneuverability. This ensures a comfortable ride while maintaining durability and long-lasting performance.

Responsive Hydraulic Disc Brakes:Equipped with hydraulic disc brakes, our product ensures precise and powerful braking performance. Riders can have confidence and control, even during high-speed rides or challenging terrains.

Convenient and Secure Battery Position: The battery is intelligently placed in the down tube of the frame, offering a low center of gravity for enhanced stability and handling. Additionally, the position provides easy access for charging and maintenance.

Long-Lasting and High-Capacity Battery:Our product features a 17.5 Ah Samsung battery, offering reliable and long-lasting power. With its high capacity, riders can enjoy extended rides without worrying about running out of battery.

Customization Options: Our product allows customers to customize both the color and logo according to their preferences. This ensures a personalized and unique look, tailored to suit individual styles.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
